destinations.descriptions: Inventario turístico de MINCETUR, enlaces individuales en el código y el panel del destino.
destinations.coordinates: Featured six: OSM / Wikimedia and SIGMINCETUR for Cconoc. Regional catalogue: SIGMINCETUR references, with OSM landscape reference for Pampachiri.
destinations.note: Geographic focus references, not verified entrances. Ampay represents an area; Cconoc now uses the thermal-baths reference from SIGMINCETUR rather than the associated village. Routes exclude conflicting coordinates.

storytelling.implementation: Adaptación propia en React + MapLibre; cámara por clic y flechas, sin Scrollama.

imagery.attribution: Mapbox / Maxar / OpenStreetMap / Improve this map, visible in the map; official Mapbox logo shown with satellite imagery.
imagery.configuration: VITE_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env.local; public token supplied by the project owner, not from the reference repository.
imagery.rendering: 512 x 512 photographic tiles (@2x, jpg90); canvas density 2, antialias, LOD 2/4, terrain pitch 48 degrees and exaggeration 1.1. Camera zoom up to 18; tile requests up to 20.
imagery.note: Coverage, capture date and native photographic detail vary by location. This is imagery draped on real elevation, not photogrammetric building models. Without a public token, EOX Sentinel-2 remains available.

fallbackImagery.licenseNote: La sección para 2016 permite CC BY 4.0; las capas 2018–2025 tienen otra licencia y no se usan.
fallbackImagery.attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016 & 2017) · CC BY 4.0 · EOX::Maps
fallbackImagery.rendering: Imagen raster sobre DEM real; colores naturales y contraste 0,03, sin sombreado adicional en satélite. Canvas a densidad 2 y antialias, selección LOD 2/4 para la imagen, cámaras a 48 grados, zoom fotográfico máximo 13. Sin textura generada ni modificación de coordenadas.
fallbackImagery.note: Mosaico histórico, no captura en tiempo real ni modelo fotogramétrico. No se reutiliza el token de Mapbox del repositorio de referencia.

logo.usage: Unmodified official logo displayed at its native 88 x 23 size.

regionalResearch.note: All retrieved records are documented, including historical entries, internal sectors and missing/conflicting coordinates. This is not a guarantee of universal or currently open attractions. No computed road geometry, optimal itinerary or live travel times. Source distance discrepancies are retained. Historical Tres Cruces is preserved separately from the current Sacclaya carnival ficha that uses code 8320.
